[
  {"step":1,"file":"test/fuzz/hts_open_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":106,"var":"data,size","code":"uint8_t *copy = malloc(size); memcpy(copy, data, size);","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are copied into a heap buffer so the fuzz target can pass them to htslib unchanged."},
  {"step":2,"file":"test/fuzz/hts_open_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":112,"var":"copy","code":"memfile = hopen(\"mem:\", \"rb:\", copy, size);","note":"The raw input becomes the backing store for an in-memory hFILE stream."},
  {"step":3,"file":"test/fuzz/hts_open_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":117,"var":"memfile","code":"htsFile *ht_file = hts_hopen(memfile, \"data\", \"rb\");","note":"htslib wraps the memory stream in an htsFile and probes the format from the attacker-controlled bytes."},
  {"step":4,"file":"test/fuzz/hts_open_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":122,"var":"ht_file->format.category","code":"switch (ht_file->format.category) { case sequence_data: view_sam(ht_file); case variant_data: view_vcf(ht_file); }","note":"The detected category selects the parser path that will interpret the same input as SAM/BAM or VCF/BCF."},
  {"step":5,"file":"test/fuzz/hts_open_fuzzer.c","function":"view_sam","line":41,"var":"in","code":"sam_hdr_t *hdr = sam_hdr_read(in);","note":"For sequence data, the parser reads a SAM header from the attacker-controlled stream."},
  {"step":6,"file":"sam.c","function":"sam_hdr_read","line":null,"var":"header text","code":"Header parsing copies and tokenizes fields from the input stream into internal structures.","note":"Malformed header content can drive later length/offset calculations in the SAM parser."},
  {"step":7,"file":"sam.c","function":"sam_read1","line":null,"var":"record fields","code":"Record parsing consumes the remaining attacker-controlled bytes after the header.","note":"The record decoder uses parsed lengths and offsets to access record data."},
  {"step":8,"file":"sam.c","function":"sam_read1","line":null,"var":"decoded record","code":"Internal helpers compute field lengths and copy/inspect auxiliary data.","note":"A crafted record can make the parser read past the end of an allocated buffer, triggering the heap-buffer-overflow read."}
]
